_comment: Ports and behaviour of SimReady assets, keyed by asset folder. Ports: id, kind (pipe | shaft | pulley | conveyor_in | conveyor_out), pos [x,y,z] in meters in the asset's local frame (Y up, bottom centered) or at [fx,fy,fz] as fractions of its bounding box, dir (outward), diameter_m. Assets not listed get detected ports (pipe rims, shafts of spinning joints, conveyor ends). Override or extend in %APPDATA%/SenseSim/plant/catalog.json, or with the plant_define_port tool.
